constraints.name: stok_hareketi_check
constraints.def: CHECK ((((hareket_turu)::text <> 'TRANSFER'::text) OR ((kaynak_sube_id IS NOT NULL) AND (hedef_sube_id IS NOT NULL) AND (kaynak_sube_id <> hedef_sube_id))))

constraints.name: stok_hareketi_check1
constraints.def: CHECK ((((hareket_turu)::text <> ALL ((ARRAY['SIPARIS'::character varying, 'GELIS'::character varying])::text[])) OR ((kaynak_sube_id IS NULL) AND (hedef_sube_id IS NOT NULL))))

constraints.name: stok_hareketi_check2
constraints.def: CHECK ((((hareket_turu)::text <> 'SATIS'::text) OR ((kaynak_sube_id IS NOT NULL) AND (hedef_sube_id IS NULL))))

constraints.name: stok_hareketi_hareket_turu_check
constraints.def: CHECK (((hareket_turu)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['SIPARIS'::character varying, 'GELIS'::character varying, 'TRANSFER'::character varying, 'SATIS'::character varying])::text[])))

constraints.def: CHECK ((((tur_kodu)::text <> ALL ((ARRAY['TEST_SURUSU'::character varying, 'TESLIMAT'::character varying, 'PERIYODIK_BAKIM'::character varying, 'SERVIS_GIRIS'::character varying, 'SERVIS_TESLIM'::character varying])::text[])) OR (arac_vin IS NOT NULL)))

constraints.name: randevu_calisan_id_tsrange_excl
constraints.def: EXCLUDE USING gist (calisan_id WITH =, tsrange(baslangic, bitis) WITH &&) WHERE (((durum)::text <> 'IPTAL'::text))
